description: Estimate in euros what a ContexteTech resource costs to run with common AI models, from the week's list prices. Use it when the user asks about cost, budget or the cheapest model. For a prompt or context: input and output tokens, cost per call for each model and batch discount; for a dataset: cost of one pass over all rows and a fine-tuning estimate on rented GPUs (hours and offers); for a model: memory (VRAM) needed and GPU offers that fit. Returns available: false with a note when no estimate exists for that type.
name: estimate_cost
title: Estimate the cost
